Dusk (medium)
A relatively tough
theater with missions
requiring precise flying
ability.
----------------- Welcome to RDU ^international Airport ----------------
Mission Code Name : Thread of death
Direction         : North
Distance          : 12 miles
Difficulty        : 6
To the north the aliens have a spread out fuel storage facility which
appears to have no active defenses.  Recon teams have reported no active
KLA sites or AA.  The site has a rather strange layout.  The fuel tanks
are arranged in twisting line like beads of oil on a string.  Our
analysts think the quickest way to blow all the dumps to to fly slowly
along the path, taking out each fuel tank as you fly over it.
The recon team referred to some strange blinking spheres;  If these
are what we think they are, get your mission done as quickly as possible,
or else those crazy ground vehicles will be making your life difficult!
Mission Code Name : Field Day
Direction         : East
Distance          : 12 miles
Difficulty        : 4
A distribution point for alien recon ground vehicles has been causing
us too much grief to tolerate.  Get out there and take out all the
sites and vehicles you can find.
There is one suspended AA installation which should be a piece of cake.
This should be your first target, since we think it is a top notch gun.
Be careful out there, though.  Intelligence  has reported a
significant concentration of KLA activity stemming from the epicenter
of the vehicle sites.  Our advice is to come in fast blasting away at
those KLA sites to eliminate them before trying to attain the objective.
Don't hesitate to make use of your bombs.  If things get too hot,
burn the emergency booster rocket and get home fast for a quick repair.
Mission Code Name : Overnight Express
Direction         : South South West
Distance          : 8 miles
Difficulty        : 3
One of our top spies has just finished a sabatoge mission at a
strange installation which is suspended at 10,000 feet.  Before blowing
up the alien orb, he has found some enemy intelligence which is critical
to our operations in this area.
Your mission is to land at the suspended airstrip, get out of your
plane, and meet with him on the alien platform.  He will give you the
package, and signify all is well with the classic 'Thumbs up'.  When
you have that signal from him, consider your mission complete.  Get back
in your plane, and head home.
Mission Code Name : Field of Flak
Direction         : West
Distance          : 20 miles
Difficulty        : 4
The aliens have a strong active defense around an orb to the west of
here.  We've had the ground forces sweep the area clear of AA and KLA
sites many times.  Each time, they manage to rebuild in a couple of days.
A brave recon team went in for a dangerously close look and discovered
a couple portals located near the center of the enemy area, suspended
at a height of only about 250 feet.  They have been transporting
supplies in through these portals as fast as we can destroy them.
Now the situation is worse.  The newest portal has its destination
set up to be directly over our airfield.  This portal must be
neutralized immediately.  There are two portals.  One is red, one is
the color of the sky.  We want the sky colored one.
Your weapons cannot destroy a portal, but we need you to fly through
it so that our technical boys can get a fix on the exit point above us.
You may have some trouble getting through the portal.  AA and KLA
activity is extremely heavy.  The good news is that only three of the
AA are of the lethal variety.   Find those dangerous AA, and take them
out before attempting to make the portal.
Recon reports at least two leftover high-grade KLA's patroling, with
many sites for the dumber varieties on the ground.
Remember that to get through the portal, you must keep your nose
pointed ABOVE it.  How much above depends on your airspeed.  It might
be a good idea to review your documentation.
Arrakis  (medium)
The experimental test aircraft
is being given a chance at some
real missions.  Try your hand at
high-speed combat on this dried-up
desert world.
----------------- Welcome to RDU ^international Airport ----------------
Mission Code Name : Curveball
Direction         : North
Distance          : 30 miles
Difficulty        : 4
Far to the north of here there is a stronghold with a generator orb.
We have been unable to touch this site before due to the intense KLA and
AAA activity.
We now put all our hopes in the new experimental aircraft.  With its
great speed the KLA's and AAA hopefully can be outrun.
Mission Code Name : Willy Wonka's Saucer Factory
Direction         : West
Distance          : 10 miles
Difficulty        : 5
To the west is a large saucer making facility.  Take out these sites
and clean up the runaway saucers.
Mission Code Name : Romper Room
Direction         : East North East
Distance          : 8 miles
Difficulty        : 2
Floods of reports of mental disturbances lead our intelligence team
to look for a mindbender in the area.  Sure enough, a new alien base has
popped up to the East of here.
Drop a bomb on that mindbender to free our forces from that hideous
mental attack.
Mission Code Name : Guinea Pig
Direction         : South East
Distance          : 14 miles
Difficulty        : 6
We haven't been able to ascertain the effect of portals on the
experimental fighter yet.   We need you to fly through two of the four
portals at the alien base to the southeast of here.
Also, take out all that tofu at the site as a secondary objective.
Mission Code Name : Sommerset
Direction         : South
Distance          : 14 miles
Difficulty        : 6
By now you should be able to land this feisty aircraft pretty well.
Although your plane isn't ideal for this mission, it's all we've got.
Go South to the suspended airstrip at 15,000 feet.  Land and get the
secret info from the spy there, and bring it back to us.
Flatland (Med Hard)
Flatland is a grassy prarie planet.
The targets are spread across the
ground with a minimum of force
fields.  If you like flying against
AAA and KLA's, try this theater.
Warning: On this planet the air is
a very thin dense layer.
Mission Code Name : Pandora's Box
Direction         : South South East
Distance          : 20  miles
Difficulty        : 4
Here is a mission which really should be for the ground forces, but
this time it's up to us.  There is a site 20 miles south of here which
has an orb that is very well defended with force fields.  Your
secondary mission is to take out the saucer site on the roof, but the
primary objective is the generator orb that is lying on its side inside
the protective shields.
The force fields are so effectively placed that the orb is
inaccessible from the air.  Set your plane down very gently on the
grass, and then taxi over to the parking lot.  Take an assassin bomb
into the fortress, and place it in the middle of the fallen orb.  It
may take more than one bomb, so be prepared to get back to your plane
for more bombs.
Mission Code Name : French Poodle
Direction         : South East
Distance          : 15  miles
Difficulty        : 4
There's a nasty little gathering of AAA, Mortars, and KLA's to the
Southeast of here.  Go take it all out.
Mission Code Name : Garden Patch
Direction         : North East
Distance          : 21  miles
Difficulty        : 4
There's a small fuel facility located Northeast of here.  It is
protected by passive defense and KLA's only.  Even though there are no
AAA to deal with, getting at these buggers may prove to be difficult.
Don't bother trying to take out the blue flashing based orb, it is a
new type which is almost indestructible.
------------ Welcome to Dulles International Airport -------------------
Mission Code Name : Cerebral Dynamite
Direction         : North West
Distance          : 20  miles
Difficulty        : 2
The enemy has set up a mindbender unit to the Northwest of this
airstrip.  Although the installation of an MB unit is always a threat,
in this case it is a real emergency.
Our intelligence has uncovered an alien scheme to modify a mindbender
to instantly drive all humans within a 50 mile radius completely insane.
At this moment, the top brass along with the evil alien scientists are
celebrating the activation of the unit by partaking in a mind-altering
ceremony.  Your mission is to sneak upon them, and blow up the MB unit,
as well as neutralizing all the aliens.  This may be enough to kill the
project permanently.
The mindbender is operating normally at the moment, so be prepared to
face some effects from the MB unit as usual.
Mission Code Name : War of the Worlds
Direction         : North East
Distance          : 23  miles
Difficulty        : 4
There are 4 saucer sites more than 20 miles North East of here.  One
site is about 14 miles distant, and then there are two more farther
Northeast.  Take out these sites, and also any saucers which are left
in the air.
Mission Code Name : Free For All
Direction         : North North East
Distance          : 5  miles
Difficulty        : 4
To the north is a very spread out mishmash of enemy forces.  Your
mission is to destroy dumps, mindbenders, and or anything else you care
to blow up.  There is some difficult stuff out there, but enough mission
objectives to really get a decent score.
Start out at your airstrip, and fly due north to engage.
Mission Code Name : Corncob
Direction         : West North West
Distance          : 20  miles
Difficulty        : 2
The largest fuel facility to date is laid out to the North West of
here, with only KLA's for defense.  Blow up the fuel depot, and detonate
the generator orb as a secondary objective.  The orbs are all disguised
with light distorters, so it's up to you to sort things out when you
get there.
The layout of this storage area is a bit odd...
------------------ Welcome to the Weedsport Airport --------------------
Available Missions:
Mission Code Name : Country Club
Direction         : South South West
Distance          : 12  miles
Difficulty        : 4
We have learned of a secret meeting of alien commanders from all over
this theater.  Among them are going to be some of the monsters
responsible for the incineration of Kansas City and Montreal.  We need
a gutsy pilot to land his plane, and proceed on foot to kill all
aliens with his handgun.
Choose a protected location to park your plane, or you may be walking
home.
Mission Code Name : Swiss Cheese
Direction         : North East
Distance          : 7  miles
Difficulty        : 4
We don't know what their hiding up to the North East, but whatever
it is, it must be good.  There are more than 5 top notch AAA sites
guarding a lonely orb.  Take out the orb any which way you can.
Mission Code Name : Eye in the Keyhole
Direction         : East
Distance          : 7  miles
Difficulty        : 2
The aliens have setup a generator orb under a blanket of forcefields.
The problem is that they left a little hole in the center to breathe
through.  Take out the orb, but don't let the enemy KLA's blow you
a new orifice.
Take off from your airstrip and head due east, you can't miss it.
----------------- Welcome to RDU ^international Airport ----------------
Mission Code Name : Stacked Deck
Direction         : North West
Distance          : 12  miles
Difficulty        : 3
Three saucers of varying quality are parked in a vertical stack to
the Northwest of here.  Your mission object is to blow the orb and its
stack to kingdom come.
Mission Code Name : Field 'o Flak
Direction         : North North East
Distance          : 15  miles
Difficulty        : 4
There is concentration to the north which is a heavy concentration
of enemy AAA.  Fuel dumps are disguised as small purple spheres.  Your
mission is to destroy the orb and the fuel dumps.
--------------- Welcome to Crickety Point Landing Strip ----------------
Mission Code Name : Tribender
Direction         : North North East
Distance          : 15  miles
Difficulty        : 3
Three mindbenders are set up amidst a concentration of shopping carts.
Blow them up with assassin bombs.
------------ Welcome to Sweetly Bending Oak Aircraft Park --------------
Available Missions:
Mission Code Name : Learner's Permit
Direction         : South East
Distance          : 8  miles
Difficulty        : 3
A saucer is parked on the ground amidst an outpost 8 mi south east.
There is AAA protecting the site, and some ground transports milling
around.  Try to cause as much damage to the saucer before it panics
and takes off.  They have the aircraft hemmed in so tightly that there
is a good chance of it hitting their own force fields while trying to
escape.
Mission Code Name : Chocolate Sprinkles
Direction         : West
Distance          : 7 miles
Difficulty        : 3
To the west is a very spread out fuel storage facility.  It is poorly
defended with AAA and KLA sites.  Your orders are to take out all the
fuel storage spheres.
Mission Code Name : Saucer Simplicity
Direction         : North North East
Distance          : 7 miles
Difficulty        : 2
The is an undefended lone saucer site to the north of here.  Take out
the orb and the saucer site there.  Also take out any saucers which
launch from the site.
Mission Code Name : Desperate Hammerblow
Direction         : North West
Distance          : 7 miles
Difficulty        : 5
There is a refinery for the new alien superfuel used only in the top
of the line KLA sites near here.  The defenses are formidable AAA and
KLA.  These defenses are so tough that it may be impossible to limp
home after receiving the damage that will be dished out to you.
However, intelligence reports that there are several portals near the
generator orb, and at least one of these portals will pop you back over
this airfield.  Your mission is to take out the fuel dumps, and then
escape the enemy fire via the portal.  Be ready to bail in case your
plane becomes to damaged to fly.
Mission Code Name : Timothy O'Leary
Direction         : North East
Distance          : 15 miles
Difficulty        : 5
The medical staff in the surrounding airfields are reporting an
anomalously high number of cases of nausea.  We believe the aliens to
be using some kind of machine which interferes with our minds.  The
center of the effect lies at a site northeast of here.
Your mission is to find the cause of the disturbance, and if possible
neutralize it with an assassin bomb.  They have built their gathering
near an abandon airstrip.  Land your plane and do the search on foot.
This outpost is protected by high-q AAA, and there also appears to be
a saucer site on the premises.
Nearby airstrips with more missions
North: Easter Island Municipal Air Travel Center
East:  Weedsport Airport
-------- Welcome to Easter Island Municipal Air Travel Center ----------
Mission Code Name : Cubic Lattice
Direction         : West
Distance          : 11 miles
Difficulty        : 3
Here is yet another fuel storage facility.  Here there are no obvious
active defense system, although in past attacks there have been systems
triggered by air attack, so keep vigilant.  Take out all the fuel
spheres.
Mission Code Name : May Pole
Direction         : East South East
Distance          : 6 miles
Difficulty        : 3
An increase in enemy ground transport operations has prompted us to
finally attack the vehicle sites to the west of here.  There is  AAA
and KLA defense.  The curious mounting of the AAA sites is no doubt an
experiment.
Your mission objective is to destroy all ground vehicles and their
sites.  You may blast the orb for dessert if you like.
-------------- Valmart Airstrip and Family Value Center ----------------
Mission Code Name : Ant Hill
Direction         : North West
Distance          : 3 miles
Difficulty        : 2
There is a large number of ground transports in our immediate
vicinity.  Though these are mostly just a nuisance, the problem has
increased steadily until something must be done soon.
Take out all vehicles and vehicle sites near the orb North West of
here.  Beware of deathballs.
Take off right from your airstrip, and head north west.  You can't
miss this large gathering of enemy forces.
Mission Code Name : Newton's Mistake
Direction         : North East
Distance          : 13 miles
Difficulty        : 2
The aliens are just starting a new construction project to the
North East of here.  Go in there and trash their orbs, but be careful.
The scientists are getting some strange readings from that area.
Iceworld ( Hard )
This theater is a winter world.  The
aliens on this planet use force fields
abundantly.  Some of the toughest
missions to date are in this theater.
The gravity is very weak, and the
atmosphere extends a long way up.
Mission Code Name : Bat Cave
Direction         : East South East
Distance          : 20 miles
Difficulty        : 6
To the East lays a force field tunnel with orbs.  Two of the orbs
contain a think tank for the enemy's top military brass.  Take out the
orbs, and all the fuel dumps.  This mission requires precision flying
to thread the tunnel.
Mission Code Name : Trapdoor
Direction         : North West
Distance          : 20 miles
Difficulty        : 4
There is an airfield 20 miles Northwest of here at 10000 ft.  There
is a generator orb there which is only accessible on foot.  Hop up there
and blow up the orb.
Use caution when landing.  It is advisable to land your plane while
flying the plane in a northerly direction.
Mission Code Name : Bats in the attic
Direction         : South South West
Distance          : 20 miles
Difficulty        : 3
The largest TRFRU spy station found to date is located 20 miles south
of this location.  Your mission is to take out all the tets.
Mission Code Name : Pot o' Gold
Direction         : Unknown
Distance          : Unknown
Difficulty        : 2
Our instruments have detected four new generator orbs in the area, but
at the moment, our directional equipment has been damaged by
electromagnetic beams coming from the spy sky station.  Your job is to
seek out these orbs and destroy them.
------------ Welcome to Dulles International Airport -------------------
Mission Code Name : Hornet's Nest
Direction         : South East
Distance          : 10 miles
Difficulty        : 5
There are a number of portals distributed around a vertical stack
of generators.  These appear to be a new type, and their function is
unknown to us.  Go out there and fly through all the green portals.
There are KLA sites a aplenty, so watch your tail.  There are two
non-green portals at the bottom of the stack which you may find useful
in case of emergency.
Direction         : North East
Distance          : 20 miles
Difficulty        : 6
A field of ticks, tets, and metamorphs lies to the Southeast of here.
It is guarded by intense AAA.  Go in and try to stay under the cover of
the forcefields as you pick off the enemies resources.  Beware of the
pull of the generator orb.   Although the orb is open to attack, you
may want to leave the force fields up, as those 8 AAA sites will chew
you up like a lump of Skoal.
Mission Code Name : High Treason
Direction         : Up
Distance          : 3.6 miles
Difficulty        : 4
Up above our airstrip is another airstrip at about 20000 feet.  Go
up there and take out the mindbender and generator orb.  Don't try to
fight any deathballs up there, as you plane cannot maneuver worth a
bean at 20000 feet.
Your assassin bomb is a highly sophisticated device, which shapes the
blast so as not to harm its user.  Therefore where you stand during
detonation is very important, especially at 20000 ft.  If the bomb does
not appear to work, try again, but stand in a different place.  Don't
be afraid to jump up and plant the bomb above or inside the mindbender.
------------------ Welcome to the Weedsport Airport --------------------
Mission Code Name : Pinpoint Challenge
Direction         : Up
Distance          : 3.31 miles
Difficulty        : 4
The enemy has placed mindbenders near this airfield, and they must be
destroyed before everyone has to evacuated due to mental stress.  The
problem is that the aliens have located the benders directly over the
airfield.  Since the benders can only be taken out by bombs, you'll have
to bomb them from the air.  Don't let any bombs hit our buildings, or
you will be in deep trouble.
Mission Code Name : Speed Racer
Direction         : South West
Distance          : 25 miles
Difficulty        : 2
Here is a milkrun for you.  We have a problem with enemy ground
vehicles 25 miles Southwest of here.  Your mission objective is to
destroy all the shopping carts.
Mission Code Name : SkyBox
Direction         : South East
Distance          : 20 miles
Difficulty        : 4
There is a fuel storage facility protected by airborne AAA to the
Southwest of here.  Blow up the fuel dumps, the orb is optional.
----------------- Welcome to RDU ^international Airport ----------------
--------------- Welcome to Crickety Point Landing Strip ----------------
Mission Code Name : Killer Bee Mitosis
Direction         : North North East
Distance          : 5 miles
Difficulty        : 6
A lone saucer has been sighted to the Northeast.  Go blast it to
pieces.  You may even be able to see it from the runway.  Take off from
this airstrip and head due north until you see it.
Mission Code Name : Breadbox
Direction         : North
Distance          : 25 miles
Difficulty        : 5
An alien site to the north takes the form of large box.  Take out
the resource items.
------------ Welcome to Sweetly Bending Oak Aircraft Park --------------
Mission Code Name : Holland Tunnel
Direction         : South South West
Distance          : 13 miles
Difficulty        : 4
A minor fuel dump facility is located to the South.  It may take some
fancy flying to blow the orb.
Mission Code Name : Sky Maze
Direction         : West
Distance          : 15 miles
Difficulty        : 4
The hopittyhops have created a spy station at 20000 feet in the air
somewhere out to the west.  Climb up and eliminate all the tofu for us.
Be careful up there, your plane will no respond so quickly at high
altitude, but the KLA's will not be affected.
-------- Welcome to Easter Island Municipal Air Travel Center ----------
Mission Code Name : Attic Stairs
Direction         : West South West
Distance          : 17 miles
Difficulty        : 3
A mindbender outpost has been erected in the sky at about 10000 ft to
the West.  Land the plane at the airstrip, and take out the mindbenders
with assassin bombs.  There are two alien guards standing nearby, but
aliens of low stature will jump to their deaths rather than face
combat.
Mission Code Name : Shell Breath
Direction         : North West
Distance          : 21 miles
Difficulty        : 6
There is a generator orb to the north west which we believe powers an
underground facility.  The orb is protected by extremely heavy AAA.
Since they can probably rebuild an orb there relatively quickly, your
mission objective is to destroy their investment in AAA batteries.
There are two forcefields which you may be able to use as cover.
There are also two portals there of an unknown type there which may be
of use to you.
After the AAA is gone, the orb should make a tasty morsel.  Nothing
like battling topnotch AAA to make one hungry for an undefended target.
-------------- Valmart Airstrip and Family Value Center ----------------
Mission Code Name : Tube Shooter
Direction         : West North West
Distance          : 21 miles
Difficulty        : 4
The aliens have set up a portal to directly over our airstrip which
needs taking out.  None of the weapons on your plane are sufficient to
do the job, but to use our land-based weapons we need to get a fix on
where you pop into existence above the airstrip.
The portal entrance is at the end of a tunnel of forcefield.  This
tunnel is located at low altitude 21 miles West of here.  Just fly
there, thread the tunnel, and pop out over our airfield here.  Once
we get a fix on the exit side of that portal, the rest will be easy.
Mission Code Name : Devil's garage
Direction         : North
Distance          : 18 miles
Difficulty        : 4
There is a site to the north consisting of a number of indestructible
orbs, and one destructible orb which is protected by open ended box
of forcefields.  Some of the orbs may have pseudo-grav capability.
Go in and take out the orb which is in the rear of the structure.
Midnight
Midnight is a difficult planet, the
action takes place in the dead of night.
Enemy forces surround your singular
airstrip, and intelligence information
is non-existent.
The gravity is 1/3 earth, and the
atmosphere is thin.
----------------- Welcome to RDU ^international Airport ----------------
No information available, all our intelligence officers have been
shipped out due to mental illness.  You're on your own.
The only information left behind is that there is an indestructable
orb which can only be taken out by suiciding your plane into it.  Make
sure you aren't in the plane when it hits.
Milk Runs (Easy)
This theater of operations consists of
many easy missions for the user who is
not yet familiar with the game.  The
missions are created to show the variety
of object types without the frustration
of getting shot out of the sky minutes
after taking off.
Mission Code Name : Gimme Shelter
Direction         : South East
Distance          : 14  miles
Difficulty        : 3
The set up consists of an almost enclosed orb, with some fuel dumps
and tets scattered around some haphazard walls.  There's some mediocre
KLA sites and AAA as active defense.  Your objective is to nail the
TRFRU and Fuelers.
Mission Code Name : Litter Boxes
Direction         : North North East
Distance          : 7 miles
Difficulty        : 5
This is perhaps your first really difficult assignment.  We've got an
orb holed up in a tight fortress of forcefields, perhaps untouchable.
It is defended by some bumble bees and 4 toughie AAA batteries.
This orb looks like a good target for the ground forces, since it may
be too well protected from air attack.  In this case it's the fuel and
TRFRU we are after.  The defenses here are strong, and it may take some
fancy flying to get them all.  Take your time, and stay away from the
AAA in the center.
You can probably see the mission from the airstrip.  Take off and fly
due north.
------------ Welcome to Dulles International Airport -------------------
Mission Code Name : Devil's Aquarium
Direction         : West
Distance          : 3 miles
Difficulty        : 5
We've got a real problem on our hands.  Just west of this airfield
a gathering of enemy forces has grown until the threat is too great to
ignore.  Since lately we have been concentrating mostly on resource
targets, until now we have ignored the piecemeal concentrations to our
west side.
But recently the enemy defenses have grown to the point where they
cannot be ignored.  Enemy missiles our attacking our planes on the
ground, and the AAA batteries our playing havoc with all flights to our
neighboring airfields.
Your mission is to take out all the AAA and KLA sites in the area.
Don't hesitate to break off, and try to make it back to save your
plane.  You can always come back to fight another day.
The mission is on your left as you sit on the airstrip.  You should be
in the thick of it right after take off.
Mission Code Name : Demolition Derby
Direction         : East North East
Distance          : 9 miles
Difficulty        : 3
Rescue operations have been hampered by the development of a group
of enemy ground transport sites located to the east of here.  Your
mission is to finish off all vehicles and vehicle sites ( wire frame
triangles on ground).  They are defended by three missile launchers,
so keep an eye on your six while you chase down those shopping carts.
Mission Code Name : Elevator Shaft
Direction         : North
Distance          : 13 miles
Difficulty        : 3
In the never ending quest for a good arrangement for passive defense,
our enemies have erected an ugly challenge for our pilots.  We don't
know what they will eventually construct at this site, and we hope to
eradicate this gathering from the map before we find out.
Take out the generator orb.  It is protected by force field and AAA
batteries.  If you don't feel like flying down the throat of the
smokestack, try making high altitude dive bombing runs, and pull off
before you end up flying down the shaft.
Mission Code Name : Sleeping Dragons
Direction         : West
Distance          : 11 miles
Difficulty        : 4
To the west is a fuel dump facility which needs to be taken out.
Use caution when firing, some booby traps may be triggered by your
fire.
Two missile launchers provide active defense for this target.  These
appear to be better than typical KLA sites, so keep alert and don't
let any deathballs sneak up on your tail.
Although your mission objective is the fuel, it might be a good idea
to take out the orb first, so you have a better chance of a clean shot
at the dumps.
Mission Code Name : Leggo my Eggo
Direction         : East North East
Distance          : 14 miles
Difficulty        : 5
Intelligence has determined that several of the enemies top technical
military AI units have been loaded onto a saucer to the East of here.
At some point we think they are abandoning this theater of operations
for a more secure area.
Your job is to show them just how insecure this area is for them.
Blow that saucer to smithereens.  We have reason to believe that they
are still in the process of loading the airship, so get in there and
get as many shots in as you can before it lifts off.
Enemy defenses are heavier than normal.  The defense of the area is
based on force fields, AAA, and KLA sites.
------------------ Welcome to the Weedsport Airport --------------------
Available Missions:
Mission Code Name : Canal Lock
Direction         : North
Distance          : 6 miles
Difficulty        : 3
Take out an orb which is protected by both balloons and force fields.
There is some tofu there which should be taken out, but your main
objective in this mission is to take out the generator orb.
This is a mission where there is an obvious choice of attack.
This mission is visible from your airstrip.  Simply take off and fly
due north.
Mission Code Name : Flaming Frisbee
Direction         : South South East
Distance          : 8 miles
Difficulty        : 3
Ground observers have spotted 3 saucers flying at low altitude about
8 miles west from our position.  You may have run across them already
if you flew here from Sweetly Bending.
Your mission is to take at least one of the three out.  They don't
appear to be the lowest of quality, so be prepared to evade any KLA's
which they may launch at you.
Your mission start coordinates are set to the last known position of
the saucers.  If you have been in the area for a while, they very well
may have spread out.
Mission Code Name : Hot Tin Roof
Direction         : East South East
Distance          : 8 miles
Difficulty        : 2
The enemies are getting a little more clever about force field
placement.  Here it is difficult to get a shot in from the top, so you
must come in at about 1000 ft.
Your mission objective is to go after the ticks and tets, but here
I would take out the generator station first, so that those force fields
will drop.
----------------- Welcome to RDU ^international Airport ----------------
Mission Code Name : Center of Attention
Direction         : South
Distance          : 9 mile
Difficulty        : 2
Some ground based AAA has been forcing routine flights between here
and Weedsport to follow an inconvenient course.  If you have flown here
from Weedsport, you will have seen it.  This thorn in our side must be
removed ASAP in order to keep our supply lines open.
Your secondary target is the orb, which seems to be what the AAA is
guarding.
Mission Code Name : Sleeping Dogs
Direction         : West North West
Distance          : 13 mile
Difficulty        : 2
This mission could be a more than it appears.  As far as we can tell,
it looks like another fuel dump situated around an unprotected orb.
However, you are the third pilot we've sent out against this site, so
we are warning you now to be cautious, and be ready for anything.
One note:
Upon closer investigation, recon planes have determined that some
of the fuel dumps appear to be smaller in size, and blink occasionally.
They appear to be harmless, since even a low pass by the unarmed recon
plane did not initiate any enemy reaction whatsoever.
Mission Code Name : SaucerWorks
Direction         : North North East
Distance          : 8 mile
Difficulty        : 3
The number of enemy bombing raids in our area has stepped up
dramatically in recent weeks.  The source seems to be coming from a
site located 8 miles north of here.  Eliminate all the saucer launch
facilities there, and clean up all the airborne saucers you can find.
Beware of a new kind of passive defense which looks like a cloud
of bumble bees.  It may look relatively harmless, but the unwary pilot
may get stung.
Make sure none of the saucers head our way, and keep an eye on your
tail for saucer launched enemy missiles.
Mission Code Name : Smoking Pursuit
Direction         : East North East
Distance          : 10 mile
Difficulty        : 3
A small fledgling full storage facility has begun operation out in
the eastern quadrant.  These are apparently guarded by four missile
sites, the quality of which varies from dumb to mediocre.  Also they
have placed 4 force fields in the area.
We have evidence to suggest that the enemies' own missiles are not
immune to the force fields.  A possible technique to shake persistent
deathballs might be to let them run through their own defenses.
Your mission objective is to demolish all of the enemy fuel reserve
tanks.  You may take out the orb and KLA sites if you wish.
--------------- Welcome to Crickety Point Landing Strip ----------------
Mission Code Name : FireFly
Direction         : West South West
Distance          : 9 miles
Difficulty        : 3
A swarm of tets is hovering over an orb about 9 miles west of here.
This is being protected by three ground based AAA sites.  It might be
a good idea to take out the AAA before digging into the tofu.
The primary mission objective, however, is to blast those tets out of
the sky.
Mission Code Name : Tearjerker
Direction         : North
Distance          : 7 miles
Difficulty        : 4
To the north is a gathering of 4 AAA sites, and 4 KLA sites.  In the
center is an orb, and hung up in air are three force fields.  We think
the enemy is planning to construct some bomber sites, or perhaps another
fuel storage facility there.
Your job is to take out the AAA and dball sites now, before the
defenses can be strengthened more.  The force fields possibly can be
used to our advantage, so the orb may not be the place to start
unleashing your fury.
You can see this mission from your airstrip.  Take off and fly due
north until you are in the thick of it.

Mission Code Name : Dead Cookie
Direction         : North
Distance          : 1 mile
Difficulty        : 1
An enemy saucer has been sighted north of the airport.  Head straight
for it right after takeoff.  Saucers are tough cookies, so don't be
sparing with the missiles.  This saucer looks like one of the dumber ones,
so it should be a piece of cake.  Bear in mind that even these dumb ones
have been known to make bombing runs against our airfields.
Mission Code Name : Splintered Spinners
Direction         : West
Distance          : 5 miles
Difficulty        : 1
To the west is a small gathering of virtually unprotected enemy
structures.  At approximately 3000 ft is a set of spinning devices
thought to be used for spy purposes.  Take these out, but be careful to
avoid colliding with the platform beneath the devices.
On the surface below is a generator orb.  It is destroyable, but at
this point we should leave that target for the ground forces.
Mission Code Name : Rebouncer
Direction         : South South East
Distance          : 10 miles
Difficulty        : 2
To the south is a platformed orb at about 1000 ft.  Balloon defenses
are it's only protection.  The balloons appear to be indestructible,
but they stop ordinance, and flying through them doesn't appear to be
a good idea.
Take your time and take aim at the orb from far away, and come in
blasting with guns and missiles.  Those orbs can take over 70 hits,
so have some patience and be prepared to make many passes.
Mission Code Name : Tofu Sandwich
Direction         : North North East
Distance          : 13 miles
Difficulty        : 2
Here is another spying attempt, which we hope you can eliminate without
too much trouble.  They've decided to protect their tets ( the official
name is Tetrahedral RF receiving units, or TRFRU ) with force fields.
Apparently they could not enclose the TRFRU's completely without
hampering the performance of the detectors.  So what they've done is
make a big tofu sandwich, and your job is to eat it.
If you take out the generator orb, the shields will drop, but at this
point, we recommend you leave this orb for the army.

East:  Weedsport Airport
-------- Welcome to Easter Island Municipal Air Travel Center ----------
Mission Code Name : Topsy Turvy
Direction         : West North West:
Distance          : 10 miles
Difficulty        : 1
Another saucer has been sighted, this one may be the type to launch
some defenses.  It was last seen heading out west at low altitude, but
climbing.  They have been known to loop around and make a bombing run,
but these things are pretty much unpredictable.
Look for a low flying blinking dot off to the west.  It may take some
flying before it shows up.
Mission Code Name :  Spitting Turtle
Direction         : West South West:
Distance          : 8 miles
Difficulty        : 2
Intelligence reports the first sighting of fixed active defense
in use by the enemy forces.  There are four triple-A batteries guarding
a solitary tofu.  The ever-present generator orb holds up the platform.
At present, those AAA sites are the biggest threat to our air
superiority.  Take out these sites as the top priority, then take out
the tet if you desire (that is, if the enemy hasn't destroyed it with
his own artillery.  The orb can be destroyed if you wish, but it is not
a mission objective.
Remember that with AAA, the best defense is a good offense.  Keep
those guns blasting away, because your hail of bullets can explode the
AA shells before they reach you.  If your plane gets damaged, consider
your position carefully.  You may want to return to fight another day,
as there are so few planes available in this sector.  They are a
precious resource.
Mission Code Name : Lover's Leap
Direction         : North
Distance          : 3 miles
Difficulty        : 3
The aliens have confused us again.  During the night they have
erected some kind of new apparatus.  They have set up a force field and
generator, but also some kind of strange small blue octangonaloid.
We saw a saucer fly through it, our eggheads became very excited.
Anyway, what we need is a volunteer to fly through it.  The scientists
claim it will not kill you instantly (Thanks a lot, guys), but how they
can tell from here, I don't know.
Behind the experimental grid is a regular force field, there may not
be enough room to pull away from that force field after getting through
the grid, but your plane should survive well enough to get back to
base so we can analyze your plane.  Also, note your altitude before
you go in, the men in the white coats want to know every detail.
No shooting is necessary in this mission.  Just fly in slowly with
your flaps engaged, and try to get the plane to fly through the small
blue rectangle, then turn and come back to base.
The target looks like a small sky-blue rectangle with shorn corners.
It is suspended at a low altitude (maybe 500ft) in front of a large
force field.  Approach from the south, heading due north.  Use the two
grounded tets on the ground as cues to help you line up.  You might
want to use the flaps to slow your air speed to give you more
maneuverability.  Keep your nose pointed slightly above the target, or
you'll find yourself too low at the last minute.
Your secondary mission objective is to kill the generator orb which
powers the force field.  You might want to save this for later on when
you have more skill taking out ground targets.  These secondary
missions must be completed before claiming a theater complete.
You can see this one from the airstrip.  Take off and head North.
Mission Code Name : Apple Pie
Direction         : East
Distance          : 4 miles
Difficulty        : 2
Here's a chance to catch the buggers with their pants down.  As we
speak, our spherical friends are trying to get a new structure set up
to the east of us.  So far all they have managed to string together is
two orbs in tandem, and one misplaced force field.  By the time the
ground forces could get there, they may well have had a change to get
some formidable defenses together, so it's up to us.
The orbs are undefended, and mounted on the ground.  Watch your
altitude when attacking ground targets, it is by far the most common
cause of death for younger pilots.  When the altitude warning light
comes on, pull up hard!

-------------- Valmart Airstrip and Family Value Center ----------------
Mission Code Name : Birds of Prey
Direction         : East
Distance          : 10 miles
Difficulty        : 2
This will be perhaps your first experience with KLA's.  A KLA is a
Kinetic Locking Antiaircraft Missile Defense, with the MD dropped for
brevity.  ( Also called 'Kevin's Little Angels after Kevin McDoodle,
the first pilot to be blown out of the sky by one. )
KLA's are simplistic enemy smart missiles which lock on to your
tail.  When the get a lock on you, they light their afterburners at
come at you at full speed.  When a KLA is locked, you can tell because
the outside color of the whole missile flashes.  Your onboard radar
system tracks them ( The display will represent them as light green
dots)
Anyway, to the east is an orb with two missile sights mounted on a
light purple platform.  Intelligence indicates that these KLA sites are
an older model, and you should be able to out maneuver them easily.
The sites look like small rings, suspended not far above the platform.
Your primary mission is to take out these sites.  They quite hardened,
so be prepared to make many passes using guns and missiles.  Your
secondary mission is to take out the orb.
Mission Code Name : Patty Cake Maker
Direction         : North
Distance          : 10 miles
Difficulty        : 2
Intelligence has identified a possible site which is launching saucers.
There is already at least one saucer in the vicinity, and as their
numbers multiply, our airfields are in graver danger.  Your mission is
to destroy this saucer site.
A saucer site looks like a shallow square pan with an 'X' in the
bottom.  As with other sites it is reasonable tough.  This particular
site is suspended over an orb on a small platform.   There are two AAA
batteries there to protect it.
First take out the site, unless it looks like the saucer may be
heading our way.  Once the site is gone, then clean up an saucers left
in the air.  Of course the orb is an optional secondary target.
Mission Code Name : Kuwait's Revenge
Direction         : West
Distance          : 8 miles
Difficulty        : 2
These aliens have much to learn about defending their resources.  To
the west is fuel storage facility which seems to be unguarded.  Unlike
your other targets so far, these fuel dumps are located on the ground.
The most important lesson for this CBM ( Confidence Building Mission)
is to watch your altitude.
Fuel dumps are spheres with girder structure around the perimeter.
They blow fairly easily with a few missile hits.  Your mission is to
blow all their stored fuel to kingdom come.  When your CMPLT light
signifies the mission end, you should be leaving behind a nice
collection of smoking wreckage.

Mission Code Name : Insult to Injury
Direction         : North
Distance          : 8 miles
Difficulty        : 1
Our attack aircraft have put a serious dent in the bug-eye's fuel
supply.  In an attempt to protect their storage facilities better, they
have been trying to enclose them in force fields.  Our recon teams have
reported that they are having serious problems with the force field
effect detonating the fuel tanks.  Get in the air right away and destroy
their generator orb while they are distracted with the force fields.
If you fly low over the fuel dumps, you may get a glimpse of some of
the alien work crews.
There is reported one fuel installation that is in no danger from the
force fields.  You may want to take this one out after blowing the orb.
( NOTE:  This mission is visible from your airstrip.  You may start from
the standard starting point by hitting <CR> or you can just take off
from this airstrip and fly there yourself. )
Mission Code Name : Unlucky Ufo
Direction         : East North East
Distance          : 14 miles
Difficulty        : 3
An enemy saucer has just lifted off to the east of us.  Get out there
on the double and blow it out of the sky.   Heavy KLA activity has been
reported in that area, so keep an eye on your rear view at all times.
As you may recall from your training, KLA's are fooled by pulling up
or down at the last minute, then pounding them with your cannons as
soon as they pass in front of you.  Also dropping a bomb when one is
right on your tail will trigger their detonation too early, thus
allowing you to escape damage.
Those saucers can take a beating, so don't economize on missles and
ammo.  You can tell by the pitch of the whoosing sound how close they
are to being destroyed.  Some of the more advanced saucers will make
bombing runs on your airstrip, and spout KLA's for defense.
Mission Code Name : Baka Bomb
Direction         : West
Distance          : 14 miles
Difficulty        : 3
To the west of here is an alien complex which is wreaking havoc on our
operations.  Unfortunately, the generator orb seems to be a type which
is indestructible with normal ordnance.  The only way to destroy this
fiendish devices is by ramming it with your plane.
This is just as well, since there is some really tough resistance on
this mission, and you might well be walking back anyway.
Get the plane on an imminent collision course with the orb, then eject
at the last moment.  Becareful to time it correctly, since the plane
can rebound from the explosion, and you may find yourself going down
with the ship!
The intelligence officers assure everybody that the fact that the
destruction of your aircraft will not count against you as a lost
plane.
Mission Code Name : Heart of +
Direction         : South
Distance          : 18 miles
Difficulty        : 3
An enemy intelligence complex has sprung up to the south of us.   Deep
in the center of a fortress lies your target.  By taking out this orb
you will deny command an control for a large portion of the enemies
forces.
Getting at this target will require some technique.  Possible methods
might be to dive bomb from the top, or coming in low and slow up the
chute.  Beware of screaming up one of the corridors... if you are
coming up on your target too fast, you may not have enough time to get
the necessary number of hits in.  Then you will find it difficult to
pull around the still-intact orb without hitting the walls.

Mission Code Name : Hopping Mad
Direction         : West South West
Distance          : 12 miles
Difficulty        : 2
Take out an orb with an assassin bomb.  The orb is 100% protected by
force fields, so you'll have to land your plane in the sand, and
approach this one by foot.  Note that you will not survive if you jump
from the top step all the way to the ground.  Try planting the bomb
over the orb, and letting it fall into the sphere.
Mission Code Name : Sky Hopping
Direction         : South East
Distance          : 8 miles
Difficulty        : 3
How are your jumping muscles feeling?  We're having an outbreak of
mental health problems here at the intelligence center.  It has been
discovered that the source is an alien mindbender unit located at
around 15,000 feet to the Southeast of here.  Lord knows why, but they
have suspended an airstrip up there which we think you can land on.
Although recon has not identified the exact position of the bender,
it must be up there somewhere.  Get up there, and blow up that bender
with an assassin bomb.
Warning:  Do not take out the orb before attacking the mindbender, or
you may ruin your chances of ever completing this objective!
Mission Code Name : Bed of Nails
Direction         : North

Difficulty        : 4
Take out two suspended orbs.  They have a curious arrangement of
AAA beneath them, and watch out for some KLA's.  Also make sure you
take out all the AAA sites as a secondary mission.

respond a little slower due to the thinner air.
You can see this mission suspended in the air from your airstrip.
Take off from runway and take this garbage out.
Mission Code Name : Killer Party
Direction         : North North West
Distance          : 17 miles
Difficulty        : 5
Some aliens are having a gathering at a site North of here.  The word
from intelligence is that it is a celebration ceremony in honor of
the historical firestorming of New Orleans on Earth.  Your orders are to
toast every last one of the monsters with extreme prejudice.
There is an airstrip handily nearby to land on, so this should be a
relatively easy mission.  However, be careful, we've already lost two
pilots at this site.

Mission Code Name : Operation Bud Nip
Direction         : South West
Distance          : 12 miles
Difficulty        : 7
The aliens have concluded that they cannot keep operations going on
this planet due to our relentless attacks.  In response, a fringe group
of aliens has decided to take matters into their own hands.  They are
working on detonating the whole planet into pieces with an anti-matter
bomb.

planet, this act would eliminate and entire race of friendlies.  In
addition to the loss of all our forces here, mankind would surely lose
perhaps our only chance for some allies in this struggle.
Land your plane on the strip, and hop down there to take out those
lunatic aliens before they destroy us all.

Mission:      Through the hoop
Direction:    North
Distance:     15 mi
Difficulty:   6
We are attempting to trace the exit point of a portal located to the
north.  Fly through the portal and return to base.  This mission is much
more difficult than it looks due to the 4 indestructible generator orbs.
It appears they may be attractor-types.
This mission can be seen from the airstrip, so take right off and
fly straight there.
Mission:      Radio Ace (Mother of all remote control missions)
Direction:    WNW
Distance:     13 mi
Difficulty:   8
One of the largest power generating facilities on the planet is
located to the west of our position.  Since all these orbs are the new
nigh-invulnerable type, up to now we could do nothing about it.
Recently, the aliens have placed an airstrip near there with more than
a half-dozen captured planes for evaluation.  Your mission is to fly in
there, land, and then take out all the indestrucible orbs by crashing
the planes into the orbs.
There is a platform about 1/2 way down the airstrip which would be
ideal for remote control flying.  You are to proceed to the end of the
airstrip, enter a plane, taxi it to a good starting position, and then
exit it and walk back to the platform.  Then take off in the plane via
remote control (caps lock), and crash it into the orbs, on at a time.
Mission:      Icarus
Direction:    East
Distance:     13 mi
Difficulty:   3
Some generator orbs are trying a new defense.  Three of them are
suspended at 34,000 feet in an attempt to get beyond our flight ceiling.
Use whatever means available to you to get up there and blow those
suckers up.
Mission:      The Hot Box
Direction:    North East
Distance:     13 mi
Difficulty:   5
There is a gathering of enemy forces to the north east of here.  Go
take out all the KLA and AA sites.  Beware of the suspended orbs.
Mission:      Suspended Insanity
Direction:    West
Distance:     12 mi
Difficulty:   2
A mindbender is located near a suspended airstrip.  This MB must be
taken out with an assassin bomb planted while on foot.
Mission:      Saucer Frenzy
Direction:    South
Distance:     9 mi
Difficulty:   6
The saucer sites are producing waves of saucers which are devastating
our airfields.  Take out all the saucers and their sites.  Take out the
high quality site first, or else you may end up in trouble.
Mission:      Michael get your bush down
Direction:    South East
Distance:     13 mi
Difficulty:   5
Some suspended tofu is causing havoc with our communications.  Take
out all the TRFRU, and beware of the indestructible orb.

Mission:      Cuckoo's Nest
Direction:    North
Distance:     15 mi
Difficulty:   4
Use your bombs to destroy a mindbender 15 miles north of the airstrip.
The bender is protected by forcefield walls and some AA.  Be careful on
your way out to the mission, there are some scattered enemy forces.
Engage these if you wish, but your mission objective is the mindbender.
Mission:      Hanging Fruit
Direction:    East
Distance:     13 mi
Difficulty:   4
At 15,000 feet, a generator orb is providing the power for several
KLA and AA sites.  Take out the orb, but keep an eye out for enemy
defenses.  Remember that your plane will not handle as well at higher
altitudes.  Intelligence reports topnotch AA mounted precariously above
the orb's inverted platform.
Take out the generator and get out of there, or else be ready to mix
it up with the KLA.  Taking out the remaining KLA sites is optional.
Don't forget to use your emergency rocket booster to rocket home if you
need to outrun some enemy deathballs!
Mission:      The Golden Path
Direction:    South
Distance:     9 mi
Difficulty:   4
To the south lies a fuel dump facility arrange in a line.  This setup
is just begging for an air attack!  Blow all those fuel tanks to
kingdom come.
Mission:      The Halls of Malevolence
Direction:    West
Distance:     12 mi
Difficulty:   5
The aliens have quite a nice setup out to the west of our postion.
The orders from the brass are to go out there and help them redecorate.
Take out the orb to bring the walls down, then get the heck out of
there if the defenses are still up.
It is a long haul back to the airstrip from there, so you might want
to stick around and take out those topnotch KLA sites which will
popup during your attack.  Otherwise you may be playing tag with ace
deathballs all the way home.
White Sands Testing Ground
White Sands is the testing
grounds for the latest aircraft
prototypes.  There are no enemies
in this theater, but there are some
practice targets.
Since there are no combat aircraft
in this theater, it won't be much fun
for rookies.
